verdict.rationale: Kick documents several ways to get data out: the Tax Package downloads a single Excel file with year-end financials, reports sync as live data into Google Sheets, and the CLI and MCP can pull transactions and financial statements. However, none of this is presented as a complete, documented export for leaving the product, and the formats are report-oriented (Excel/Sheets) rather than a full ledger dump. Missing for 10: a documented full-workspace or all-data export, open-format exports (e.g. CSV/JSON) of the general ledger, journal entries, rules, attachments and audit trail, account-closure/offboarding guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of a clean exit.
